text:
elle: quick heads-up — onboarding snag: our sampleapp README tells people to set `REDWOOD_API_KEY` but the CLI checks `RW_API_KEY` first. People rotating keys keep hitting 401s. anyone run into this?
matt: yup saw it on support queue this morning. CLI fallback order is `RW_API_KEY` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY` -> token file. not documented anywhere. :grimacing:
sneh: oof. we should pick one canonical env var. my vote: `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, `REDWOOD_ORG`, `REDWOOD_PROJECT` — matches product names. also add a clear warning when legacy var present.
jordan: can we add lightweight telemetry when fallback happens? e.g. `cred.source=fallback:RW_API_KEY`. helps triage when users have multiple vars set.
samira: rotation pain: containers with long-lived processes don’t re-read envs after we rotate keys. staging job rotated keys and a few services returned 401 for ~2m until restarted. we need refreshable creds or an explicit reload signal.
elle: proposal: SDK should use fallback order `REDWOOD_API_KEY` > token file (`~/.redwood/token`) > metadata/instance service. If `RW_API_KEY` is seen, emit a deprecation warning. Also add a `--rotate` helper to sampleapp to rebootstrap creds.
matt: SG. I can own SDK change. Implementation idea: on 401, try reloading env + token file once, then retry request once (with a small backoff). avoids rolling restarts for many cases.
sneh: I’ll update sampleapp and README to standardize env names and add a quick `redwoodctl auth status` example showing which cred source is active. also add a dev-mode flag `--warn-on-legacy` so devs see warnings without noise in prod.
ops-bot: scheduled-rotation-bot: automated key rotation completed for `staging` at 2024-06-14T03:00Z. 3 unique services reported transient 401s, recovered automatically after restart.
jordan: for retries, we should be careful not to mask real auth failures. SDK should only auto-retry if auth header changed after reload (not blind retry). also emit `auth.retry_attempt=1` in tracing.
samira: SIGHUP support sounds good — I'll sketch a small helper that signals processes in k8s via `kubectl rollout restart` or sends SIGHUP for pid 1. but better if SDK supports live reload to avoid ops.
elle: I'll draft a short RFC with checklist: doc updates (sampleapp + quickstarts), SDK fallback order + 401-reload behavior, telemetry fields, and a `redwoodctl auth rotate` UX. volunteers? :raised_hands:
matt: happy to take SDK.
sneh: I’ll handle sampleapp+docs.
jordan: telemetry + traces for retries, on it.
samira: I'll draft the operator guidance (SIGHUP vs restart) and the small k8s helper.
elle: thanks all — will link RFC in #devex once sketched. small wins first: sneh pls push that sampleapp README change today so onboarding doesn't keep tripping support.
